% titletoc's run-in entries, \titlecontents*, at the top level of the
% table of contents: in an article with hyperref, run-in sections with
% the optional separator and end and \thecontentspage in the entry, and
% run-in subsections under them, beside a \dottedcontents subsubsection.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{3}
\titlecontents*{section}[0pt]{\bfseries}{\thecontentslabel\ }{}
    {\ \thecontentspage}[\ \textbullet\ ][.]
\titlecontents*{subsection}[1.5em]{}{\thecontentslabel\ }{}
    {, \thecontentspage}[;\ ][.]
\dottedcontents{subsubsection}[3.8em]{}{3.2em}{1pc}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{Alpha}
Text of alpha.
\subsection{Alpha one}
Text of alpha one.
\subsubsection{Alpha deep}
Text of alpha deep.
\subsection{Alpha two}
Text of alpha two.
\section{Beta with \emph{italic} and $y_1$}
Text of beta.
\end{document}
